messages.author: 0cb1ab1dff2bfeb6
messages.subject: Inconsistencies between dataframe and telemetry coordinates
parts:
Hello,

I have some lizard data that I've been playing around with in ctmm. While working through the data, I noticed a bit of an inconsistency between the telemetry object coordinates and the dataframe coordinates. I went ahead and isolated the X and Y coordinates from both the data frame and the telemetry object. Then I went ahead and subtracted the dataframe X values from the telemetry object X values, and I did the same for the Y values. While the overall differences are not too large and consistent throughout the dataframes (64 for the X coordinates and 7 for the Y coordinates), there were three specific instances of extremely large differences in my Y coordinates (200). Upon further investigation, it looks like those specific Y coordinates are similar to other Y coordinates in the dataframe, but they seem to be quite different in the telemetry object. So, this leads me to think that there might be some error in converting the data to a telemetry object. Below is a minimum working example of my code to get the differences between the telemetry object (tX, tY) and the dataframe (X,Y) coordinates

Example Data (Problem coordinates bolded for simplicity)

X<-c(489742, 489765, 489975, 489663, 490047, 489811, 489739, 489708, 489665, 489448, 489695, 489837, 489653, 490062, 489791, 489793, 489844, 489840, 489839, 490059, 490057, 490053, 489870, 489664, 489746, 489747, 489749, 489797, 489802, 489751, 489749, 489746)

Y<-c(3722962, 3722942, 3723221, 3723081, 3722837, 3723117, 3722617, 3722610, 3722724, 3722538, 3722399, 3723074, 3723054, 3723156, 3722844, 3722839, 3723009, 3723013, 3723014, 3723163, 3723161, 3723165, 3723005, 3722484, 3722449, 3722450, 3722245, 3722560, 3722556, 3722615, 3722616, 3722613)

tX<-c(489806.7,489829.7,490039.7,489727.7,490111.7,489875.7,489803.7,489772.7,489729.7,489512.7,489759.7,489901.7,489717.7,490126.7,489855.7,489857.5,489908.5,489904.7,489903.7,490123.7,490121.7,490117.7,489934.7,489728.7,489810.7,489811.7,489813.7,489861.7,489866.7,489815.7,489813.7,489810.7)

tY<-c(3722955,3722935,3723214,3723074,3722830,3723110,3722610,3722603,3722717,3722531,3722392,3723067,3723047,3723149,3722837,3722639,3722809,3723006,3723007,3723156,3723154,3723158,3722998,3722477,3722442,3722443,3722238,3722553,3722549,3722608,3722609,3722606)


Code

#Reading in dataframe
CleanedDataTM<-read.csv(ClanedDataTM)

#Changing the dataframe to a telemetry object
CleanedDataTMt<-as.telemetry(CleanedDataTM, timeformat="auto",timezone="UTC", timeout=Inf,datum="NAD27",
                             na.rm="row",mark.rm=FALSE,keep=FALSE,drop=TRUE)

#Applying the right projection
projection(CleanedDataTMt)<- "+proj=utm +zone=12 +datum=NAD27 +units=m +no_defs"


X<-CleanedDataTM$X
Y<-CleanedDataTM$Y
tX<-CleanedDataTMt[[5]]
tY<-CleanedDataTMt[[6]]

#Finding the differences in coordinates
X-tX

-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.5
-64.5,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7,-64.7

Y-tY

7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,200,200,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7


Just to clarify because I'm not sure how much sense I'm making, I'm ok with the overall 65m and 7m differences between my two objects because, except for those two 200m differences, it's consistent throughout the data. I'd like to find out why I'm getting those two 200m differences in my Y coordinates. The fact that coordinates #16 and 17 appear to be much more different from other coordinates in the telemetry object compared to the dataframe lead me to believe that there's something going on with the telemetry object. Any ideas at all about what might be going on here? Thanks for any help!

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Inconsistencies between dataframe and telemetry coordinates
parts:
Hi Jason,

I hadn't coded the datum argument for UTM importing. But I fixed that and updated from sp transform to sf transform, and now the projection errors here are under 1 millimeter.

You can update from GitHub via: remotes::install_github("ctmm-initiative/ctmm")

Best,
Chris

messages.subject: Re: Inconsistencies between dataframe and telemetry coordinates
parts:
Hi Jason,

You have a datum="NAD27" argument in as.telemetry() and also +datum=NAD27 appended to the end of your UTM zone column. I removed the extra argument from your UTM zone column (making it just 12), and the re-projection errors were then under a millimeter.

I'm not sure why repeating the exact same datum argument in a PROJ string would have any effect, but it probably wasn't coded for.

Best,
Chris
